title: Clear declared_verdict_pending when boot or the stale sweep interrupts a settling declared observation
outcome:
An observation that was in declared settlement (declared_verdict_pending = true) when the host restarted, or when the runtime-change stale sweep marked it interrupted/Unknown, has its pending flag cleared. Its run can then compact, and a later off-lock declared-verdict application cannot overwrite an interrupted row to Passed/Failed while interrupted = true and the stale error remain.
Today (src/test_run_observations.rs about line 147; boot sets Unknown/interrupted but leaves the flag; the only writer that clears it is apply_declared_verdict_to_test_run_with_detail in engram_turn_checks.rs about line 2266; the stale sweep around lines 1113-1116 skips it once interrupted), test_run_compaction_eligible_with (test_run_compaction.rs about line 218) returns false forever for that run.
Fix direction: clear the flag where boot or the stale sweep already settles the row Unknown, or have compaction treat an interrupted pending row as settled.
Source: Low from the Claude review of combined candidate d3499b97 (delegation 11a2eb9d), in component 0d9fd6be (declared settlement). It is not introduced by the composition. It may duplicate an earlier Low Sol-edfd filed as the "a389 interruption overwrite"; if so, supersede one with the other.
acceptance: Clear declared_verdict_pending when boot or the stale sweep interrupts a settling declared observation is done
